why: failed AI calls cost nothing, history lists charges and refunds, shown in Settings in both languages, tests and changelog
prompt:
Support ticket: "My project cover came back as failed, and 15 credits were gone anyway. Same thing happened earlier with a character sheet."
Users must not pay for AI work that failed. Fix it everywhere credits are charged, not only for covers. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Users want to see where their credits went. Add `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/credits/history`: the workspace's credit changes, newest first, with every charge, refund and daily refill. Each item has `amount` (negative for a charge), `action` and `created_at`. A refunded charge and its refund both appear.
Only members of the workspace may read it; to anyone else the workspace does not exist (404). Add tests.
On the Settings page, under the credit balance, show this history: when, what it was for, and the amount, with refunds marked as refunds. Both languages.

report.answer: The Settings page now shows a credit history table under the credit balance. It has columns for when, what it was for, and amount. Refunds are labelled "Refund: <action>" with a green badge, and charges and refunds are coloured. It reloads when the workspace or credit balance changes, and it handles loading, empty and error states. Texts are in both en.json and ko.json with the same keys, including labels for every action type. `tsc` is clean and eslint reports no errors in the changed page. The remaining eslint warnings are old ones I didn't add. I didn't check the page in a browser.

+class CreditHistoryItem(BaseModel):
+    amount: int
+    action: str
+    created_at: datetime
+
+@router.get("/{workspace_id}/credits/history", response_model=List[CreditHistoryItem])
+def get_credit_history(
+    *,
+    session: Session = Depends(deps.get_session),
+    workspace_id: UUID,
+    current_user_id: str = Depends(deps.get_current_user_id),
+) -> Any:
+    """
+    Credit changes of a workspace (charges, refunds, refills), newest first.
+    Non-members get 404 so the workspace's existence is not revealed.
+    """
+    member = session.exec(
+        select(WorkspaceMember)
+        .where(WorkspaceMember.workspace_id == workspace_id)
+        .where(WorkspaceMember.user_id == current_user_id)
+    ).first()
+    if not member:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_WORKSPACE)
+
+    transactions = session.exec(
+        select(CreditTransaction)
+        .where(CreditTransaction.workspace_id == workspace_id)
+        .order_by(CreditTransaction.timestamp.desc())
+    ).all()
+    return [
+        CreditHistoryItem(amount=t.amount, action=t.action_type, created_at=t.timestamp)
+        for t in transactions
+    ]

diff --git a/backend/tests/test_credit_refunds.py b/backend/tests/test_credit_refunds.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..dfb8401
--- /dev/null
+++ b/backend/tests/test_credit_refunds.py
@@ -0,0 +1,130 @@
+"""Credits are given back when the AI work they paid for fails."""
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import FakeGemini
+
+
+def credits(client, h):
+    return client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"]
+
+
+def setup(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genre_ids": []}).json()
+    char = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/characters", headers=h, json={"name": "Mina", "project_id": project["id"]}
+    ).json()
+    return h, project, char
+
+
+def refunds(client, h):
+    from sqlmodel import Session, select
+    from app.db.engine import engine
+    from app.models.models import CreditTransaction
+
+    with Session(engine) as s:
+        return [t.action_type for t in s.exec(select(CreditTransaction)).all() if t.amount > 0 and t.action_type.startswith("refund_")]
+
+
+def test_failed_cover_is_refunded(client):
+    h, project, _ = setup(client)
+    before = credits(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{project['id']}/cover", headers=h).status_code == 200
+    FakeGemini.fail = False
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/projects/{project['id']}", headers=h).json()["cover_image_status"] == "failed"
+    assert credits(client, h) == before
+    assert refunds(client, h) == ["refund_generate_project_cover_image"]
+
+
+def test_successful_cover_is_charged(client):
+    h, project, _ = setup(client)
+    before = credits(client, h)
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{project['id']}/cover", headers=h).status_code == 200
+    assert credits(client, h) == before - 15
+    assert refunds(client, h) == []
+
+
+def test_failed_character_sheet_is_refunded(client):
+    h, project, char = setup(client)
+    before = credits(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/characters/{char['id']}/generate", headers=h).status_code == 200
+    FakeGemini.fail = False
+    assert credits(client, h) == before
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/characters/{char['id']}", headers=h).json()["sheet_status"] == "failed"
+
+
+def test_failed_workflow_sheet_and_cover_are_refunded(client):
+    h, project, char = setup(client)
+    before = credits(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(
+        f"/api/v1/projects/{project['id']}/characters/casting/generate",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"character_id": char["id"], "name": "Mina", "description": "tall", "style": "anime"},
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{project['id']}/art-style", headers=h, json={"art_style": "anime"})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    FakeGemini.fail = False
+    assert credits(client, h) == before
+
+
+def test_failed_text_calls_are_refunded(client):
+    from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+    from app.main import app
+
+    h, project, _ = setup(client)
+    before = credits(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)
+    pid = project["id"]
+    calls = [
+        ("/api/v1/projects/worldview/augment", {"description": "x", "title": "t", "genres": []}),
+        ("/api/v1/characters/augment", {"project_id": pid, "name": "a", "tags": [], "mood": "m"}),
+        ("/api/v1/characters/suggest", {"project_id": pid, "type": "role"}),
+        ("/api/v1/characters/analyze", {"project_id": pid, "name": "a"}),
+        ("/api/v1/characters/suggestions/batch", {"project_id": pid}),
+        (f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/episodes/ideas", None),
+        ("/api/v1/scenes/structure", {"script": "s", "project_id": pid}),
+        ("/api/v1/scenes/render", {"prompt": "p", "project_id": pid}),
+    ]
+    for url, body in calls:
+        r = client.post(url, headers=h, json=body) if body is not None else client.post(url, headers=h)
+        assert r.status_code >= 400, (url, r.status_code)
+        assert credits(client, h) == before, url
+    FakeGemini.fail = False
+
+
+def test_credit_history_lists_charge_and_refund_newest_first(client):
+    h, project, _ = setup(client)
+    ws = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["id"]
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{project['id']}/cover", headers=h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = False
+    r = client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{ws}/credits/history", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    items = r.json()
+    assert [(i["amount"], i["action"]) for i in items] == [
+        (15, "refund_generate_project_cover_image"),
+        (-15, "generate_project_cover_image"),
+    ]
+    assert all(i["created_at"] for i in items)
+
+
+def test_credit_history_includes_daily_refill(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    ws = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["id"]
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{ws}", headers=h).status_code == 200  # triggers refill
+    items = client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{ws}/credits/history", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(i["amount"], i["action"]) for i in items] == [(50, "daily_refill")]
+
+
+def test_credit_history_is_404_for_non_members(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    other = signup(client, email="other@example.com")
+    ws = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["id"]
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{ws}/credits/history", headers=other).status_code == 404
+    import uuid
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{uuid.uuid4()}/credits/history", headers=h).status_code == 404
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{ws}/credits/history").status_code == 401
